title: SarthiRecord
description: SARTHI (National Driving License Registry) table schema - driver licensing records and identity linkings

dl_number.description: Primary Key: Unique Driving License Number (e.g. GJ0120150001234)

driver_name.description: Full name of the licensed driver as registered with RTO

linked_aadhaar_hash.description: SHA-256 cryptographic hash of Aadhaar number for privacy-compliant identity federation

license_status.description: Current legal validity of driving privileges

linked_plate.description: Primary vehicle registration plate linked to this driver, or null

suspect_link_id.description: Cross-reference link ID to criminal or surveillance watchlist record, or null
